Definition: a spade or paddle (as having a broad end)
BiblicalUsage: The azen is a spade or paddle — the tool every Israelite soldier carried on his weapon, to dig a place outside the camp and cover what came from him. God's camp was to be holy, because the Lord walked in the midst of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this small tool preaches a large truth: God walks among his people, and holiness reaches into the ordinary, everyday things.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
